about: The arguments Claude Code (2.1.318, claude-haiku-5-5, -p, --permission-mode manual, --permission-prompt-tool mcp__postbox__permission_prompt) sent to Postbox’s permission_prompt tool in the turn recorded in permission-edit.jsonl: an Edit, then a Write (the Read before them didn’t ask). Taken from the permission cards Postbox made of them (each card keeps the call’s input as sent, and its tool_use_id). Neither carries permission_suggestions or an agent id. Both were answered { behavior: allow, updatedInput } as asked; note.txt then held “The sky is blue today.” and done.txt “done”. The Edit’s input carries replace_all: false, as the stream’s assistant message does (where it comes first), though the streamed input_json_delta never sent it.
